title: A Visit to BitClub Network Bitcoin Mining Plant in Iceland
description: This was a visit by Raymond one of Bitclub Network Miner in Africa from AchieversKlub Kenya in September 2017. Bitclub ...

asr.full_text: Wow I'm super excited to be here in Iceland right behind me the mining facility owned by BitClub Network. A lot of you coming in from Achiever's Club in Africa, South Africa, Nairobi, Nigeria, Uganda. You've invested into mining Bitcoin with BitClub Network and we keep hearing us telling you that our mining facility is located in Iceland. Now guess what? It's right behind me. I've just gone inside. I've seen our machines. Inside there we have the Antminer S9s. What I'm holding right here, these are the S5, an older generation. And I'm bringing one to you, Hannah, in South Africa, and this one we'll bring to Kenya. So, this is really exciting to be here to see how big our facility is. We have 10,000 machines right behind me. You can hear the noise and the weather may be cold but the bitcoins are very warm especially if you have it in your wallet. So thank you so much, looking forward to bringing a lot of you from Africa here to visit the facility and look at it. Thank you very much and bye-bye.

textual.context: The source is framed as an enthusiastic visit and appears promotional, but it does not contain a specific investment offer, payment instruction, or stated return guarantee.
textual.potential_relevance: The claimed BitClub Network facility and investment affiliation are presented alongside an invitation for the audience to visit, creating an identity/endorsement relationship connected to a prior investment activity.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish whether the facility, ownership claim, investment arrangement, or stated number of machines is accurate. No investment terms, fees, returns, or transaction outcomes are provided.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because the speaker promotes BitClub Network to an audience that has already invested, presenting the Iceland site and its equipment as evidence of a shared mining operation. He cites 10,000 machines and invites viewers to visit the facility to validate the mining-investment affiliation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The content links capital participation in Bitcoin mining with the BitClub Network facility and the resulting possession of bitcoins. The speaker states that viewers invested into Bitcoin mining, presents the associated mining facility and equipment, and refers to bitcoins in a wallet.
